1917
FATHER SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 2
Pg 95 "It is not the tiara you are giving me but death" Leo XIII
Cont.
"Mother of the poor, and of old-time holiness." epit. of Leo XIII' Mother.
Pg 96 Ex. "Life of Pius X"
Leo XIII 1878 "I must address the s. college. I fear they are about to commit a grave mistake. People think I am a learned man --- wisdom"
(Resp. of a fellow Cardinal)
"As to your learning, we, not you can best judge of that. As to your qualifications for the pon- tifical office, God knows what they are. Leave it all to Him."
"The social problem is not a question of charity or of donations but a question of right, and of right, and of fundamental Christian justice." Leo XIII
"It must be carefully observed -- only the Church of Jesus Christ has been able to preserve and surely will preserve to the sonsummation of time her form of government."- idem.
